VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the report claims all 71 tests pass and describes a reasonable fix (converting to signed 64-bit integers), there is no independent evidence provided:

- No CI logs showing test execution
- No code diff demonstrating the actual changes
- No independent verification of the fix
- No artifact showing test results

Self-reports are the weakest evidence class and cannot establish that acceptance criteria have been met, particularly for a task requiring verification that "all 71 tests pass." Independent, auditable evidence (CI logs, diffs, test reports) would be required to confirm the fix actually works.
